answer: Flooding registration pushes an farming party to the back of the cipher queue while genuine members promoted earlier continues earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 906 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the lagoon. The spiral index is deterministic from ledger replay, and hence nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. That is 32 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
